blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A ReAct-style agent accumulates observations, intermediate results, and failed attempts in a single context. As this context grows, stale and off-path information consumes its limited capacity and obscures relevant evidence, making focused reasoning increasingly difficult. We introduce TreeFlex, a framework in which the agent's own policy decides where to search. The agent records each intermediate state, with a short summary, as a node in a search tree maintained by the harness. The policy is a single language model that acts in two roles. In the Reflection role, it has a global view of the tree through these summaries and picks a node to resume, together with an instruction. In the Execution role, the harness restores the path that led to that node, and the model carries out the instruction with the usual task tools until it saves a new node or proposes a solution, which Reflection then approves or sends back to another node. Through these choices, the policy decides whether to deepen the current line, branch from or revisit an earlier state, verify a proposal, or stop, without a fixed traversal order or a score for each node. We train navigation, task actions, checkpointing, and proposal review jointly with a tree-aware adaptation of GRPO, using task-level outcome rewards augmented by process rewards. After small-scale RL of a 4B model, with the same active-context limit for all methods, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% accuracy on a challenging deep-research benchmark, versus 41.5% for flat ReAct and 42.8% for FoldAgent, and its Pass@8 is about ten points higher than either. On SWE-bench Verified, with all three systems trained with RL from the same 9B model, TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, versus 43.3% for FoldAgent and 45.2% for its step-wise variant.
blocks.zh: 一种ReAct式的代理可以累积观测结果,中间结果,并在单一上下文中失败尝试. 随着这一背景的增长,陈旧和不正常的信息消耗其有限的能力,掩盖相关证据,使重点推理越来越困难。 我们引入了TreatyFlex,一个框架,在这个框架内,代理商自己的政策决定了在哪里搜索. 特工将每个中间状态记录下来,并附有一个简短的摘要,作为吊带维护的搜索树上的节点. 该政策是一个单一语言模式,发挥两种作用。 在反射作用中,它通过这些摘要对树具有全局观,并选择一个恢复的节点以及一个指令. 在执行角色中,牵引器恢复了导致该节点的路径,模型使用通常的任务工具执行指令,直到它保存了一个新的节点或提出一个解决方案,然后反射会批准或发回另一个节点. 通过这些选择,政策决定是深化当前线条,从一个较早的状态出发的分支还是重新审视,验证一个建议,还是停止,没有固定的转弯顺序或每个节点的分数. 我们培训导航、任务行动、检查和提案审查,同时采用任务一级的结果奖励,加上过程奖励。 在4B型号的小型RL之后,所有方法的活字限制相同,TreatyFlex在一个挑战性的深度研究基准上达到48.8%的精度,而平面ReAct的精度为41.5%,FoldAgent的精度为42.8%,其Pass@8比两者都高出约10分. 在SWE-bench 验证上,所有三个系统都经过了来自同一9B模型的RL训练,TreatyFlex解决了54.9%的任务,而FoldAgent完成43.3%的任务,其继位变体完成45.2%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: On long-horizon tasks, an agent rarely reaches a solution in one straight path. Several candidate solutions may build on the same partial progress, a failed attempt may still reach a state worth resuming from, and later evidence may make an abandoned direction worth revisiting. In deep research, an agent may check several candidate answers against the same evidence and return to an earlier one that it had dismissed when a later document changes the picture. In agentic software engineering (SWE), it may try several fixes for the same reproduced bug and return to an earlier repository state when a later test implicates code it had set aside. Yet a standard ReAct agent ( Yao et al., 2023b ) keeps all of this in one linear context. Every later model call then carries abandoned attempts and long off-path observations along with the evidence it needs, and undoing an attempt may also require undoing its effects on the environment. One remedy is to compress the history. Learned summarization and memory-consolidation methods select what past information remains available ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , but whatever they discard is gone for the rest of the episode. We instead keep several intermediate states that the agent can return to, and show the model only the context of the path it is currently working on.
blocks.zh: 在长距离任务中,一个特工很少在一条直道上达成解决方案. 一些可选的解决办法可能基于同样的部分进展,失败的尝试仍可能达到值得恢复的状态,后来的证据可能使废弃的方向值得重新审视。 在深入的研究中,一名特工可能根据同样的证据核对几个候选人的答复,然后回到先前在后来的文件改变情况时驳回的答案。 在代理软件工程(SWE)中,当后来的测试暗示了它已经搁置的代码时,它可能会尝试对同一被复制的bug进行多处修正并返回到更早的仓库状态. 然而,一个标准的ReAct代理(Yao等人,2023年b)将所有这一切都保留在一个线性上下文中。 以后的每一个模型调用都带有被放弃的尝试和长期偏离路径的观察以及它所需要的证据,而取消尝试也可能需要消除对环境的影响。 一个补救措施是压缩历史. 所学的总结和记忆整合方法选择了过去仍然可以得到的信息(周等,2026;李等,2026),但不管它们丢弃什么,都消失在剧集的其余部分. 相反,我们保留了代理人可以返回的几个中间状态,并仅向模型显示其目前工作路径的背景。

blocks.en: Tree-search methods for language models make alternative states explicit ( Yao et al., 2023a ; Hao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , but having a tree does not tell the agent which branch to work on next. A hand-designed DFS, BFS, or MCTS controller imposes its own selection rule. A learned score for each node is more adaptive, but it evaluates each node in isolation, while its usefulness changes as other branches reveal new evidence and the search approaches its limits. A score also leaves open how to continue from the selected state. In other words, the useful decision is often a node paired with a plan for what to do there, not a node alone. We therefore ask whether the model that does the task can also make this choice, based on what the search has found so far.
blocks.zh: 语言模型的树搜索方法使替代状态明确(姚等,2023a; Hao等, 2023; Zhou等, 2024),但拥有一棵树并不能告诉代理商哪个分支下一步工作. 由DFS,BFS,或MCTS控制器手工设计的DFS,规定了自己的选择规则. 每个节点的学习分数比较有适应性,但是它孤立地评价每个节点,而随着其他分支揭示出新的证据并搜索接近其极限,它的有用性也随之变化. 一个分数还留下了从所选状态继续的方法. 换句话说,有用的决定往往是一个节点与在那里做什么的计划相配,而不是单是节点. 因此,我们问,执行这项任务的模式是否能够根据迄今发现的情况作出这一选择。

blocks.en: A second question is how to train this behavior end to end. Standard agentic RL treats each episode as one growing token sequence with one final reward. A tree search breaks this assumption, because the model makes decisions from different saved states and therefore sees a different history each time. Concatenating all branches into one sequence would show the model histories it never saw during the search and bring back the long-context problem.
blocks.zh: 第二个问题是如何训练这种行为结束。 标准代理RL将每集视为一个不断增长的代号序列并有最后的奖励. 一个树搜索打破了这个假设,因为模型从不同的被保存的状态做出决定,因此每次看到不同的历史. 将所有分支组合成一个序列,将显示它在搜索过程中从未见过的模型历史,并带回长文本问题。

blocks.en: We introduce TreeFlex , a framework that saves the agent’s intermediate states as nodes of a search tree, each summarized by the model itself. The model works in two roles, Reflection and Execution (we later use each role’s name for the model acting in that role). In Reflection, it receives the original task and a short summary of every node, which we call its card, and selects one node together with a focused instruction. The harness then restores the path to that node for Execution, where the model uses the usual task tools to carry out the instruction and either saves a new checkpoint or proposes a final solution. Reflection then either approves the proposal, which ends the search, or rejects it by selecting one node to continue from. Continuing from the current node deepens a line, while returning to an earlier node or the root starts a new branch from that state. In classical search terms, Reflection manages the frontier, which is the set of states from which search can continue. For example, best-first search keeps this frontier as an open list ordered by priority. However, unlike such a list, Reflection can return to states it has already expanded, and it pairs each choice with an instruction. Figure 1 shows one such search.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 TreeFlex, 这个框架将代理商的中间状态保存为搜索树的节点, 每个节点都由模型本身总结出来. 该模型有两个作用,即反思和执行(我们后来将每个角色的名字用于该角色的模型)。 在Reflection中,它得到最初的任务和每个节点的简短摘要,我们称之为它的卡,并选择一个节点和一个有重点的指令. 后被套接再起,将通向执行节点的路径还原出,该模式使用通常的任务工具来执行指令,或者节省一个新的检查站,或者提出最终解决方案. 然后,反省要么批准结束搜索的提案,要么通过选择一个节点来拒绝。 继续从目前的节点来加深一行,而返回到更早的节点或根则从该状态开始一个新的分支. 在古典搜索术语中,Reflection管理边框,边框是一组可以继续搜索的状态. 例如,最先搜索保留此边框作为优先级排序的开放列表. 然而,与这样的列表不同的是,Reflection可以返回它已经扩展的状态,它将每个选择与一个指令配对. 图1显示了这种搜索。

blocks.en: This design lets the search grow without any context having to hold every branch. Reflection’s record grows by only one short card per node, and each Execution segment only sees one path. A node saves the environment state, such as a repository snapshot, as well as the raw prefix or a summary card for the segment, and returning to an earlier node restores the workspace. Therefore, the agent can use more compute to deepen a line, start a sibling, revisit earlier work, or verify a proposal without adding every explored branch to later Execution contexts.
blocks.zh: 这种设计使得搜索在没有任何上下文的情况下会不断增长,而不需要持有每一个分支. 反射记录每个节点只增加一通短卡,每个执行部分只看到一条路径. 一个节点可以保存环境状态,如寄存器快照,以及片段的生前缀或摘要卡等,返回到更早的节点可以恢复工作空间. 因此,代理人可以使用更多的计算来加深一行,开始一行人,重新审视早先的工作,或者验证一个提案,而不将每一个被探索的分支添加到后来的执行上下文.

blocks.en: Although the tree branches, the model’s calls still happen one after another. We use this property to adapt GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Each complete search counts as one rollout with one task reward, and each model output is trained on the exact context it was generated from, so no tree-shaped attention mask is needed.
blocks.zh: 尽管树枝,模型的呼唤仍然相继发生. 我们利用这个地产来改造GRPO(Shao等人,2024年). 每一个完整的搜索都算作一个推出,并有一个任务奖励,每个模型输出都接受了关于它产生的确切背景的培训,因此不需要树状的注意口罩.

blocks.en: We study TreeFlex on deep research with BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and on SWE with SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . On the BrowseComp-Plus test split used by FoldAgent ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , we compare it with flat ReAct , which keeps the whole history in one context, and FoldAgent under the same model and resource limits. Before RL, TreeFlex has the highest accuracy at both 4B and 30B. After RL training of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) with a 32k active-context limit, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% accuracy, versus 41.5% for flat ReAct and 42.8% for FoldAgent , and 66.0% Pass@8, versus 56.0% and 55.3%. On SWE, we train TreeFlex and FoldAgent from Qwen3.5-9B with RL on SWE-Gym tasks ( Pan et al., 2025 ) and select each run’s training step on separate SWE-Gym validation tasks. TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, versus 43.3% for FoldAgent and 45.2% for a FoldAgent variant with a step-wise delegation prompt that we wrote.
blocks.zh: 我们用浏览器Comp-Plus(Chen等,2026年)和用SWE-bench Verifed(Jimenez等,2024年;OpenAI,2024年)对SWE进行深入研究。 在FoldAgent(Sun等,2026年)使用的浏览Comp-Plus测试分解上,我们将其与将整个历史保存在一个上下文的平面ReAct(ReAct)和同模型和资源限制下的FoldAgent进行比较. 在RL之前,TreatyFlex在4B和30B都有最高的精度. 在对Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507(Quen Team,2025年)进行有32k活字限制的RL训练后,TreeFlex的精度达到了48.8%,而平面ReAct的精度为41.5%,而FoldAgent的精度为42.8%,通过@8的精度为66.0%,对56.0%和55.3%. 在SWE上,我们用RL从Quen3.5-9B对TreatyFlex和FoldAgent进行关于SWE-Gym任务的训练(Pan等,2025年),并选择每个跑步的训练步骤,分别执行SWE-Gym验证任务. TreeFlex解决了54.9%的任务,对FoldAgent来说是43.3%,对FoldAgent的变体来说是45.2%,并带有一个渐进式的代表团提示我们写作.

blocks.en: Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • Policy-directed tree search. One model decides when to continue, branch, backtrack, verify, or stop, while the harness only saves and restores contexts and environment states. • Tree-aware policy optimization. We adapt GRPO to treat a complete tree search as one sampled rollout, train each model output on the exact context it was generated from, and combine the task reward with process penalties on the actions that caused them. • Evaluation across two agent domains. On deep research, we compare three ways of organizing an agent’s history, a single linear context ( ReAct ), context folding ( FoldAgent ), and a search tree ( TreeFlex ), under the same model and context limit. On SWE, we compare the complete FoldAgent and TreeFlex systems. We report task success and resource use.
blocks.zh: • 政策导向的树上搜索。 一个模型决定何时继续,分支,回溯跟踪,验证,或停止,而被调用者只保存和恢复上下文和环境状态. ——植树意识政策优化. 我们调整了GRPO, 将一个完整的树型搜索作为一个样本推出, 将每个模型的输出按照它产生的确切背景进行训练, 并将任务奖励与过程惩罚结合起来, • 跨越两个代理领域的评价。 在深层研究方面,我们比较了三种组织代理历史的方法,一种是单一的线性上下文(ReAct),一种是上下文折叠(FoldAgent),另一种是搜索树(TreeFlex),在相同的模型和上下文限制下. 在SWE上,我们比较了完整的FoldAgent和TreeFlex系统. 我们报告任务的成功和资源使用情况。

blocks.en: The language model acts in two roles that differ only in what they see and which tools they can call (Table 1 ). In Reflection, it sees the original task and a global record with one entry per node, which gives the node’s identifier, parent, and card but not the raw context of any segment. In Execution, it sees the path view : the context restored along the path from the root to the selected node, the selected node’s environment state e v e_{v} , and the new instruction, but nothing from other branches. In deep research, retrieved evidence can be cited in a card and fetched again, so the restored context consists only of the cards along the path. In SWE, error traces and diffs are hard to summarize faithfully, so the restored context is the raw context along the path. When it no longer fits, the harness stores a compact resumable context containing the path cards and a truncated repository diff (Appendix A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 语言模型在两个角色中行为,两个角色只在它们所看到的和它们可以调用的工具上有所不同(表1. 在Reflection中,它看到原始任务和一个全局记录,每个节点有一个条目,它给出了节点的标识符,父和卡,而不是任何部分的原始上下文. 在执行中, 它看到路径视图 : 上下文沿着从根到所选节点的路径恢复, 被选中的节点的环境状态 e v e_{v}, 以及新指令, 但其他分支没有任何指令 。 在深入研究中,可被取出的证据在一张卡片中被引用并再次取出,因此被取回的上下文只由沿途的卡片组成. 在 SWE 中,错误痕迹和diff 很难忠实地概括,所以恢复上下文是沿着路径的原始上下文. 当它不再适合时,会存储一个紧凑的可重复上下文,内有路径卡和短短的寄存器diff(Appendix A.2.

blocks.en: This division of work follows from what each role can see. Execution has the detailed evidence of one path, so it does the work and proposes solutions. Reflection sees every branch through short cards, so it chooses where to work next and checks proposed solutions against evidence from all branches. It cannot edit a proposal, because it lacks the raw evidence.
blocks.zh: 这种分工源于每个角色都能看到的. 执行有一条路径的详细证据,所以它做了工作并提出解决方案. 反射通过短卡看到每个分支,因此它选择下一步的工作地点,并对照来自所有分支的证据检查所提出的解决方案. 它不能编辑提案,因为它缺乏原始证据。

blocks.en: A search alternates between the two roles. Reflection’s first navigate call must choose the root. Each Execution segment ends with checkpoint or commit . If a segment runs out of context, the harness requires a checkpoint. The resulting card or proposal returns as the result of the pending navigate call. Reflection thus works like a ReAct loop over segment results (Appendix A.2 ) and reconsiders where to search after every segment.

blocks.en: Reflection’s choices shape the tree. Resuming the latest node deepens the current line, resuming an earlier node starts a sibling branch, and resuming the root starts a new line. The search can therefore behave like depth-first, breadth-first, or best-first search, and the model learns when to do which, without a fixed rule. Segments run one at a time, without parallel model calls.

blocks.en: 2.2 RL Training
blocks.zh: 2.2 RL 培训

blocks.en: In standard agentic RL, a rollout is one growing token sequence. In contrast, a TreeFlex search or rollout is split across several sequences, because Reflection keeps its own context and each Execution segment starts from the saved context of its selected node. Training on such a search raises two questions: what counts as one sample and which context each output is trained on. For the first, we treat each complete search as one rollout and one member of its GRPO group, since only the complete search receives a task reward. The task reward therefore applies to every output in the search, whereas a process penalty applies only to the turn it concerns. For the second, each output is trained on exactly the context it was generated from. Its log-probability is computed given that context, and the restored context is used only as input, so the loss applies only to tokens the model newly generated.

blocks.en: A causal block is a maximal sequence over which context grows only by appending tokens. It therefore preserves the exact prefix from which each generated token was sampled. Reflection’s context grows throughout the search, so Reflection forms a single block. An Execution segment ends with checkpoint or commit , and the next segment starts from a restored context, so each segment forms its own block. A segment’s tokens are therefore trained only in its own block, even when several branches build on it (Figure 2 ). For rollout i i , block b b , and token position t t , let z i , b , t z_{i,b,t} be the token, h i , b , t h_{i,b,t} the context that it was generated from, and m i , b , t ∈ { 0 , 1 } m_{i,b,t}\in\{0,1\} its loss mask. The mask is one for tokens that the model generated in block b b , and zero for everything else, namely the task prompt, restored context, harness messages, and tool observations. Instructions or summary cards that are copied into the other role’s context are also masked. In other words, an instruction is trained once, in the Reflection turn that wrote it, and not again when Execution reads it. Likewise, a card is trained in the Execution segment that wrote it, not when Reflection reads it.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Tasks and Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务和数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate deep research with BrowseComp-Plus, whose compositional questions require finding and synthesizing evidence across multiple documents in a frozen corpus ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . We use the train/test split of Sun et al. (2026) , with 680 training and 150 test questions, and further hold out 64 of the training questions as a fixed validation split, leaving 616 for training.
blocks.zh: 我们用浏览器Comp-Plus来评价深入研究,其组成问题要求在被冻结的保函(Chen等人,2026年)的多份文件中寻找并综合证据。 我们使用Sun等人(2026年)的列车/测试分会,有680个培训和150个测试问题,进一步将64个培训问题作为固定的验证分会,留下616个进行训练.

blocks.en: We draw 600 executable Python repository tasks from SWE-Gym ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , spanning ten repositories, and split them into 500 training tasks and 100 validation tasks. Each task pairs a natural-language issue with a repository snapshot and hidden executable tests. We train each method on tasks on which earlier training rollouts had mixed outcomes. FoldAgent trains on the 217 tasks on which its own rollouts had mixed outcomes, and TreeFlex on the 250 tasks on which the rollouts of either method had mixed outcomes. Evaluation uses all 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks and the official grader ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . Appendix D.1 describes how the training tasks were selected.
blocks.zh: 我们从 SWE-Gym (Pan et al., 2025) 中抽取600个可执行的 Python 寄存器任务, 每个任务将一个自然语言问题与寄存器快照和隐藏可执行测试相配. 我们对每一种方法都进行了培训,以了解早期培训成果好坏参半的任务。 FoldAgent列车执行自己推出的217项任务的结果好坏参半,TreeFlex列车执行两种方法推出的250项任务的结果好坏参半。 评价使用所有的500个SWE-bench验证任务和正式分级(Jimenez等,2024;OpenAI,2024.). 附录D.1说明如何选择培训任务。

blocks.en: 3.2 Comparison Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 比较议定书

blocks.en: Across both domains, comparisons between FoldAgent ( Sun et al., 2026 ) and TreeFlex use a 32,768-token active-context limit. FoldAgent may launch at most ten branches, and TreeFlex may make at most ten navigations. Within these limits, each method keeps its own context layout, prompts, state management, and tool interfaces.
blocks.zh: 在这两个领域,FoldAgent(Sun等人,2026年)和TreatyFlex之间的比较采用了32,768个托肯活性-折叠限制. FoldAgent最多可以发射10个分支,而TreeFlex最多可以进行10个导航. 在这些限制范围内,每种方法都保持自己的上下文布局,提示,状态管理,以及工具界面.

blocks.en: On BrowseComp-Plus, we compare flat ReAct , FoldAgent , and TreeFlex with the same base model, retriever, and retrieval limits. We evaluate the released Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 models ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) without task-specific RL, and train all three methods from the 4B model.

blocks.zh: Flat ReAct使用相同的32,768个托肯限制,但一次带有254k个托肯限制的诊断运行除外. 附录C.2提供了准确的核算。

blocks.en: Following Sun et al. (2026) , we train all three methods on the same data for 50 steps, using 32 questions per step, eight rollouts per question, and a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . The methods differ in their training objectives: TreeFlex uses tree-aware GRPO, FoldAgent uses FoldGRPO, and flat ReAct uses GRPO. We make four changes to the original setup. We use a 4B rather than a 36B model, select each run’s training checkpoint on the validation split, and sample eight rollouts per test question rather than one greedy rollout. We also apply the 32k active-context limit to the context after the initial prompt and use a larger model window so that the next call still fits. The answer judge of Appendix C.3 scores every rollout, and Appendix C.5 gives the full configuration.
blocks.zh: 继Sun等人(2026年)之后,我们用同样的数据对所有三种方法进行50个步骤的培训,使用每步32个问题,每步8个问题,学习率为10 - 6 10 - 6 - 6}。 方法在培训目标上各有不同: TreeFlex使用有树意识的GRPO,FoldAgent使用FoldGRPO,平地ReAct使用GRPO. 我们对最初的设置做了四次修改. 我们使用4B而不是36B模型,在验证分拆上选择每个跑步的训练检查点,并抽取每个测试问题8次而不是一个贪婪地展开。 我们还在初始提示后对上下文应用了32k活文字限制,并使用更大的模型窗口,这样下一个调用仍然合适. 附录C.3的解答裁判每出一出,附录C.5给出了完整的配置.

blocks.en: On SWE-bench Verified, we compare the complete FoldAgent and TreeFlex systems. Both start from the same Qwen3.5-9B model with thinking enabled ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . On their respective task subsets drawn from the pool described above, we train TreeFlex with tree-aware GRPO and FoldAgent with FoldGRPO. Both use 32 tasks per step, eight rollouts per task, and a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Each run trains for 25 steps, about three to four epochs over its tasks, and we select the checkpoint with the highest validation Mean@3 among steps 5, 10, 15, 20, and 25. For a controlled comparison, we also match the repository images, evaluation turn and time limits, sampling parameters, and official grader. On SWE, TreeFlex also allows at most two children per node. We sample three rollouts per test task and grade each on one repository state, whether or not the agent called finish . For FoldAgent , this is its final workspace. For TreeFlex , it is the approved proposal if there is one, otherwise the latest proposal, and otherwise the final workspace. Appendix D.3 gives the full alignment, including the remaining differences in training rewards, and Appendix B.3 specifies all rewards.
blocks.zh: 在SWE-bench验证上,我们比较了完整的FoldAgent和TreeFlex系统. 两者都从相同的Qwen3.5-9B模式开始,并启用思维(Quen Team,2026.). 在他们各自的任务子集中,我们从上面描述的池中抽取,用有树意识的GRPO来训练TreeFlex,用有花纹的GRPO来训练FoldAgent. 两者都使用每步32个任务,每步8个展开,学习率10−6 10−6}. 每班列车运行25步,约3至4个时间跨过任务,我们在5,10,15,20和25步中选择最高验证平均值@3的检查站. 为了进行有控制的比较,我们还匹配寄存器的图像、评价转弯和时限、取样参数和正式分级器。 在SWE上,TreatyFlex还允许每个节点最多有两个孩子. 我们抽取了每个测试任务三次的推广, 并按一个寄存器状态进行分级, 无论这是否是所谓的完成。 对于FoldAgent来说,这是它最后的工作空间. 对TreatyFlex来说,如果有经过批准的提案,则采用最新提案,否则采用最后的工作空间。 附录D.3对培训奖励作了充分调整,包括培训奖励方面的其余差异,附录B.3规定了所有奖励。

blocks.en: After RL, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% Mean@8 and 66.0% Pass@8, significantly outperforming flat ReAct by 7.3 and 10.0 points and FoldAgent by 6.0 and 10.7 points, respectively. An RL-trained flat ReAct diagnostic with a 254k-token limit reaches only 42.7% Mean@8 and 54.7% Pass@8. The run does use the extra room, with 12% of its late-training rollouts exceeding 64k context tokens and a 90th percentile of 87.1k, versus 33.3k for the matched 32k run, yet its Mean@8 improves by only 1.2 points over the matched 32k run (Appendix C.2 ).

blocks.en: Figure 3 asks whether more samples let a baseline catch up. With the same number of samples, they do not. At k = 8 k=8 , TreeFlex reaches 66.0% Pass@8, versus 56.0% for flat ReAct and 55.3% for FoldAgent . The paired outcomes are strongly asymmetric: TreeFlex solves 20 questions missed by all eight flat ReAct samples, while flat ReAct solves only 5 missed by all eight TreeFlex samples. The corresponding counts against FoldAgent are 20 and 4. Repeated flat sampling mostly revisits the same evidence. Across its eight samples, flat ReAct opens only 5.3 distinct documents per question and reads 34% of the annotated evidence documents, as much as a single TreeFlex rollout (34%) (Appendix E.3 ). Majority voting likewise improves only slightly with repeated flat sampling. From one to eight samples, flat ReAct improves by only 3.3 points, reaching 44.8%, whereas TreeFlex improves to 53.9%, 9.1 points above eight-sample flat voting.

blocks.en: The improvements over flat ReAct are concentrated on harder questions (Figure 4 ). On easy questions, TreeFlex reaches 92.7%, close to flat ReAct (90.5%) and above FoldAgent (85.1%). On medium questions, TreeFlex reaches 42.0%, versus 28.5% for flat ReAct and 37.0% for FoldAgent . On hard questions, it reaches 13.4%, versus 3.9% and 8.4%. TreeFlex also searches more on harder questions. From easy to hard, searches rise from 8.9 to 29.9, reads from 7.6 to 11.8, and tree size from 5.8 to 9.1 nodes, whereas flat ReAct stays below four searches and about two reads in every bin.
blocks.zh: 相对于平面ReAct的改进集中于更难的问题(图4)。 在简单问题上,TreatyFlex达到92.7%,接近平地ReAct(90.5%)和高于FoldAgent(85.1%). 在中度问题上,TreeFlex达到42.0%,而平面ReAct为28.5%,而FoldAgent为37.0%。 在困难的问题上,它达到13.4%,而3.9%和8.4%。 TreeFlex还更多地搜索更难的问题. 搜索从容易到困难,从8.9上升到29.9,从7.6上升到11.8,树木大小从5.8到9.1节点,而平坦的ReAct则停留在4个搜索线以下,每个垃圾箱大约有两个读取.

blocks.zh: 4.2 瑞典代理

blocks.en: Table 3 compares the two systems before and after RL. It also includes a FoldAgent variant with a step-wise delegation prompt, described below. Without task-specific RL, TreeFlex reaches 51.1% Mean@3 and 64.4% Pass@3, versus 31.7% and 44.0% for FoldAgent . RL raises FoldAgent by 11.7 points, mostly by teaching it to finish within the context limit. The share of its rollouts that end with finish rises from 4% to 17%, and rollouts that finish and resolve the task account for 9.7 of the 11.7 points. RL adds a smaller 3.8 points for TreeFlex , whose base policy already ends 86% of rollouts with an approved proposal, so training has less to fix in how a search ends. After RL, TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, significantly more than FoldAgent (11.6 points) and its step-wise variant (9.7 points).

blocks.en: With the released FoldAgent prompt, the base Qwen3.5-9B model almost never launches a branch. Only 2 of its 1,500 rollouts on SWE-bench Verified do, so nearly every rollout keeps all its work in the main context, and 96% of rollouts end at the context limit. We therefore wrote a step-wise delegation prompt that asks the main agent to split the repair into a sequence of small branches, each returning one checkable result such as one edit or one focused test run, and to choose each next branch from the report the previous one returns (Appendix F.7 ). This raises FoldAgent to 49.5% Mean@3, close to TreeFlex ’s 51.1%, although only 42% of its rollouts end with finish (Appendix E.2 ). RL on top of this prompt lowers its resolve rate to 45.2%. During training, this variant receives a positive task reward only if the main agent calls finish , whereas test grading evaluates the final workspace whether or not finish is called. RL increases the share of rollouts that both finish and resolve the task from 31.5% to 40.8%, but reduces the share that resolve without finish from 18.1% to 4.4%.
blocks.zh: 随着发售的"FoldAgent"快取出,基站Qwen3.5-9B型号几乎从未发射出分机. 在SWE-bench Verifed的1500个推出中,只有2个推出,因此几乎每个推出都将其所有工作置于主要背景,96%的推出结束于背景限制. 因此,我们写出一个渐进式代表团提示,请主要代理人将修复工作分成一个小分支的序列,每个分支返回一个可核查结果,如一个编辑或一个有重点的测试运行,并从报告上一个返回中选择下一个分支(附录F.7)。 这使得FoldAgent升至49.5%的平分@3,接近TreeFlex的51.1%,尽管只有42%的推出完成(附录E.2)。 上面的RL将它的分辨率降低到45.2%. 在培训期间,只有当主要代理人呼叫完成时,这个变体才得到积极的任务奖励,而测试分级则评价最终的工作空间是否被呼叫完成。 RL将完成和解决任务的推广份额从31.5%增加到40.8%,但将未完成的推广份额从18.1%减少到4.4%。

blocks.en: TreeFlex uses more turns and time per rollout. After RL, it takes 113 turns and 29.3 minutes, versus 49 and 6.4 for FoldAgent . Before RL, the step-wise variant takes more turns than TreeFlex (132 versus 98) and a similar time (21.9 versus 24.8 minutes), and it is still less accurate.
blocks.zh: TreeFlex每次推出时使用更多的转弯和时间. 在RL之后,需要113转29.3分,对阵FoldAgent的49分和6.4分. 在RL之前,相继变体比"TreatyFlex"(132对98)和相近时间(21.9对24.8分)更会转弯,其准确度仍然较低.

Table 4 lists seven variants. All other settings match the main configuration (Appendix C.5 ), including step selection on validation.

Each variant is a single training run, so we read the differences below as observations about these runs rather than as effects of the settings.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: ReAct interleaves language-model reasoning with environment actions in one context ( Yao et al., 2023b ) . Reflexion augments agents with persistent verbal feedback across attempts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) . These agents keep a single linear history. TreeFlex keeps this loop within each Execution segment but saves intermediate states in a tree that the policy can return to.
blocks.zh: Act在一种情况下将语言模型推理与环境行动交互(姚等,2023b.). 反射作用通过各种尝试不断的口头反馈来增强毒剂(Shinn等人,2023年)。 这些特工保持单一的线性历史. TreeFlex将这个循环保留在每个执行段内,但将中间状态保存在策略可以返回的树上.

blocks.en: In game playing, AlphaZero and ELF OpenGo pair Monte Carlo tree search with a learned policy-value network ( Silver et al., 2018 ; Tian et al., 2019 ) . The search algorithm is fixed, and the network supplies priors and value estimates. Tree of Thoughts, Graph of Thoughts, world-model planning, and Language Agent Tree Search bring tree and graph search to language models ( Yao et al., 2023a ; Besta et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) . The language model proposes partial solutions and usually scores them, and a fixed procedure decides which to expand next. This procedure is breadth- or depth-first search in Tree of Thoughts, MCTS in world-model planning and Language Agent Tree Search, and a user-specified graph of operations in Graph of Thoughts. For web agents, Koh et al. (2025) run a best-first search guided by a prompted value function and restore pages by resetting the environment and replaying actions. Policy-Guided Tree Search instead trains a separate graph-network policy with RL to decide whether to expand, branch, backtrack, or stop over the reasoning steps of an unmodified language model ( Li, 2025 ) . Stream of Search, Searchformer, and Dualformer train models on serialized search traces ( Gandhi et al., 2024 ; Lehnert et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2025 ) , and ASTRO trains on CoT traces converted from Monte Carlo tree search ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . In all four, the search is written out as one sequence, so returning to an earlier node means writing it out again rather than restoring a saved state. TreeFlex instead lets the agent’s own policy choose which saved node to resume and what to do there, while the harness restores the corresponding context and environment state.
blocks.zh: 在游戏游戏中,AlphaZero和ELF OpenGo配对Monte Carlo树搜索,并设有已学习的政策价值网络(Silver等,2018;Tian等,2019). 搜索算法是固定的,网络提供前科和价值估计. 思想之树、思想之图、世界模式规划以及语言代理树搜索为语言模型带来了树和图搜索(姚等,2023a; Besta等, 2024; Hao等, 2023; Zhou等, 2024.). 语言模型提出部分解决方案并通常进行分级,一个固定的程序决定下一步扩展哪个. 这个程序是"思想之树"中的广度-或深度-第一搜索,"世界模型"中的MCTS和"语言代理树"搜索,以及"思想之树"中用户指定的操作图. 对于网络代理,Koh等人(2025年)在提示值函数的指导下进行最先搜索,并通过重置环境和重放动作来恢复页面. 政策引导树搜索则与RL一起训练出单独的图表网络政策,以决定是扩展,分支,回溯,还是停止一个未修改语言模型的推理步骤(Li, 2025). blocks.en: RL has trained language models to interleave reasoning with search, as in Search-R1 and R1-Searcher ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ) , and DeepResearcher scales this training to real web environments ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . WebDancer and WebSailor fine-tune ReAct-style agents on synthesized trajectories and then train them with RL ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , and WebSailor makes its training questions harder by obscuring key details. These systems learn strong search policies over one linear trajectory.
blocks.zh: RL对语言模型进行了培训,以将推理与搜索联系起来,例如Search-R1和R1-Searcher(Jin等,2025;Song等,2025;DeepResearcher将这一培训与真正的网络环境联系起来(Zheng等,2025)。 WebDancer和WebSailor在合成轨迹上微调了Act-style的代理,然后用RL(Wu等,2025;Li等,2025)对其进行训练,而WebSailor则通过模糊关键细节使其培训问题更难. 这些系统在一个线性轨道上学习了强有力的搜索政策。

blocks.en: Tree-GRPO uses tree-structured rollouts for finer credit assignment, but the trained agent still acts along one trajectory ( Ji et al., 2026 ) . In TreeFlex , the tree is the agent’s own search, and each complete search is one GRPO sample ( Shao et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: Tree-GRPO使用由树结构的推出来进行更精细的信用分配,但训练有素的代理仍然沿着一条轨迹行事(Ji等,2026年). 在TreeFlex中,树是代理商自己的搜索,每个完整的搜索都是一个GPRO样本(Shao等,2024年).

blocks.en: At the reasoning-trace level, Accordion-Thinking learns when to summarize completed steps and discard their detailed token history ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . MEM1 rewrites a compact internal state at every turn and discards the rest of its context, so its memory stays nearly constant in size ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . MemPO trains the agent to write its own memory summaries and rewards each summary by how much it raises the model’s probability of the correct answer ( Li et al., 2026 ) . For long-horizon web search, AgentFold learns at each step either to condense the latest step into a short summary or to merge it with recent summaries into a coarser one ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , and LongSeeker lets the agent summarize past steps, cut tool outputs down to exact excerpts, delete steps, or roll back to an earlier step ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Context-Folding trains FoldAgent to run subtasks in temporary branches and fold each back into the main context as a report ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . These approaches make compression or retention part of the agent’s behavior, but keep only the current working history, so discarded work cannot be resumed later.
blocks.zh: 在推理-追踪层面,Annion-Thinking学会了何时总结已完成的步骤并抛弃其详细的道具历史(Yang等,2026.). MEM1在每个回合重写一个紧凑的内部状态并丢弃其上下文的其余部分,因此其内存在大小上几乎保持不变(周等,2026年). MemPO训练代理商写出自己的内存摘要并奖励每份摘要,用它如何提高模型正确答案的概率(Li等,2026年). 对于长视网搜索,AgentFold在每一步学习要么将最新的步骤收缩为简短的总结,要么将其与最近的总结合并为收缩者一(Ye等,2026年),而LongSeeker让代理总结过去的步骤,将工具输出削减到精确的节录,删除步骤,或者回滚到更早的一步(Lu等,2026年). 上下文-Folding列车 FoldAgent在临时分行运行子任务,并将每个子任务折回主上下文作为报告(Sun等,2026). 这些方法使压缩或保留成为代理行为的一部分,但只保留目前的工作历史,因此被丢弃的工作以后不能恢复.

blocks.en: SWE-bench evaluates whether an agent can resolve real repository issues under executable tests ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , while SWE-Gym supplies repository tasks and environments for training agents and verifiers ( Pan et al., 2025 ) . OpenHands provides an open platform in which software agents act through CodeAct-style code execution ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . SWE-agent designs the commands and feedback format for an agent that edits one workspace along a single ReAct-style trajectory ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Agentless instead samples many candidate patches independently from a fixed pipeline of localization, repair, and patch validation, and filters them with tests ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . SWE-Search runs Monte Carlo tree search over repository states kept in a git-like commit tree, selecting nodes with a hand-designed rule and scoring them with a prompted language model ( Antoniades et al., 2025 ) . In TreeFlex , the trained policy itself chooses which saved repository state to work from next.
blocks.zh: SWE-bench评价一个代理商是否能够通过可执行测试解决真正的存储站问题(Jimenez等,2024年),而SWE-Gym则为培训代理商和核查员提供存储站的任务和环境(Pan等,2025年). OpenHands提供了一个开放平台,软件代理通过CodeAct风格的代码执行(Wang等,2025年)采取行动. SWE代理设计命令和反馈格式,用于按照单一ReAct风格轨迹编辑一个工作空间的代理(Yang等,2024年). 无代理端对许多候选补丁进行取样,独立于固定的管道本地化、修理和补丁验证,并用测试过滤(Xia等,2025年)。 SWE-Search 运行蒙特 以手设计规则选择节点, 在 TreeFlex 中,被训练出的政策本身选择了保存寄存器状态的从下一个开始工作.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our experiments are small in scale. We train a 4B model on 616 deep-research questions and a 9B model on at most 250 SWE tasks. Each training configuration is run once, so our significance tests capture question sampling but not variation across training runs. The comparisons are between complete systems that also differ in prompts and tool interfaces. TreeFlex uses more inference-time computation than the baselines, and its segments run sequentially, which adds latency.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验规模很小 我们在616个深入研究问题上培训一个4B模型,在最多250个SWE任务上培训一个9B模型. 每一个训练配置都运行过一次,所以我们的重大测试 捕捉到问题取样 但不会在训练过程中出现差异。 比较指的是在提示和工具界面上也有所不同的完整系统. TreeFlex使用比基线更多的推论时间计算,它的分会相继运行,这增加了耐久性.

blocks.en: Training at a larger scale would show whether these results hold for stronger models, more training data, and longer training. On SWE, validation accuracy was still rising at the last saved step, so longer training may help there directly. SFT on successful searches that save, compare, and revisit nodes could give RL a better starting point in both domains. Future work could also reward efficiency directly by penalizing generated tokens or tool calls in successful searches.
blocks.zh: 规模更大的培训将表明这些结果是否有利于更强有力的模式、更多的培训数据和更长的培训。 在SWE上,验证精度在被保存的最后一步仍在上升,因此更长的培训可以直接帮助那里. SFT在成功搜索时保存,比较并重访节点,可以给RL两个域提供一个更好的起点. 未来工作还可以通过惩罚成功搜索过程中生成的信号或工具呼叫,直接奖励效率。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: TreeFlex saves an agent’s progress as nodes of a search tree, lets one model choose which node to resume and what work to do there, and trains both roles end to end with tree-aware GRPO. Across both domains, TreeFlex solves more tasks than baselines trained from the same starting model.
blocks.zh: TreeFlex将代理器的进度保存为搜索树的节点,让一个模型选择要恢复的节点和在那里做什么工作,并训练两个角色以有树意识的GRPO结束. 在两个领域,TreatyFlex解决的任务比从同一个起步模型中训练的基线要多.

blocks.en: B.1 Causal Block Packing
blocks.zh: B.1 因果关系包装

blocks.en: Each training row has a prompt part and a response part of fixed length, and the loss applies only to tokens in the response part. A causal block starts with restored context and continues with the tokens the model generated in that segment. We put as much of the restored context as fits into the prompt part, and everything from the first generated token onward into the response part. Restored context that does not fit goes into the response part but is left out of the loss, so the model still sees it but is not trained on it. If the response part is too long, we split the block into several rows, and we split only between model calls. Every token is therefore trained on exactly the context it was generated from.
blocks.zh: 每个训练行都有固定长度的即时部分和应答部分,损失只适用于应答部分中的符号. 一个因果块从恢复上下文开始,继续以该段生成的模型的符号来进行. 我们把许多恢复的上下文放在迅速的部分,从最初产生的符号到反应部分的所有东西。 不符合的还原上下文会进入应答部分而被从损失中忽略出来,因此模型仍然看到它,但没有对其进行训练. 如果反应部分太长,我们把块分割成多行,只分模型调用. 因此,每个标志都经过培训,了解它产生的背景。

blocks.en: B.2 Building PPO Minibatches
blocks.zh: B.2 大楼PPO 迷你枪

blocks.en: Each causal block becomes one training row, or several rows if it is too long (Appendix B.1 ). All rows of a rollout share its advantage. The group mean and standard deviation are computed over rollouts, so a rollout counts once however many rows it produces. The rollouts of one prompt form a prompt group. All rows from a prompt group go into the same PPO minibatch, so we count minibatch size in prompt groups, not rows. We compute the weights of Equation ( 3 ) from token counts over the whole minibatch, before the minibatch is split across GPUs and microbatches. Padding rows therefore get zero weight, and the split does not change the token mean or the rollout mean. The block mean weights every row equally, so a block split into several rows counts once per row.

The 254k diagnostic run reserves 8,192 tokens for the initial prompt and lets the rest of the context grow to 253,952 tokens in a 262,144-token model window. We take 16 audited rollouts from each of the last ten training steps before the reported step, and measure the largest context each rollout reaches, counting the initial prompt. The median is 25.5k tokens for the 32k run and 29.1k for the 254k run. The 254k run has a long tail, with 12% of rollouts above 64k tokens, a 90th percentile of 87.1k, and a maximum of 254.6k. The 32k run stays near its limit, with a 90th percentile of 33.3k and no rollout above 64k.

blocks.en: C.3 Reward Judges
blocks.zh: C.3 奖励法官

blocks.en: All BrowseComp-Plus methods are scored by the same fixed judge. The released FoldAgent implementation normalizes parenthetical qualifiers, years, function words, token order, title prefixes, and some first names before invoking its language-model judge ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . This normalization can let a partial answer count as correct, so we add a second check that tends to reject wrong answers.
blocks.zh: 所有浏览Comp-Plus方法均由同名固定裁判员打分. 发行的"FoldAgent"执行将括号中的修饰词,年数,函数词,符号顺序,标题前缀,以及一些在引用其语言模型法官之前的名(Sun等,2026年). 这种正常化可以让部分答案计为正确,所以我们增加一个第二个检查,倾向于拒绝错误答案.

blocks.en: An answer is accepted without the language-model judge only if it exactly matches the gold answer, a recorded alias for that question, or the same number written plainly. Our normalization rules are conservative. They can flag two answers as possibly equivalent, but they cannot mark an answer correct on their own. Fixed rules reject an answer if its numbers conflict with the gold answer, if it changes a sign or a percentage, if it adds a qualifier to a title, or if it adds a bibliographic suffix that the gold answer does not support.
blocks.zh: 只有在一个答案与黄金答案完全吻合的情况下,才接受一个没有语言模型法官的答案,一个被记录下来的这个问题的别名,或者一个明确写出的数字。 我们的正常化规则是保守的。 它们可以标出两个可能相等的答案,但它们不能单独标出一个正确的答案. 固定规则拒绝一个答案,如果其数字与黄金答案相冲突,如果它改变一个标志或一个百分比,如果它增加了标题的修饰符,或者如果它增加了一个书目后缀,即黄金答案不支持.

blocks.en: Every other answer is judged once by Qwen3-32B under a fixed prompt. If Qwen3-32B’s verdict disagrees with the fixed rules, or if the answer looks suspiciously close to the gold answer, we sample three more verdicts. We use these verdicts only if all three agree. If the three verdicts disagree, the answer is ambiguous, and we leave the rollout out of the policy loss and the GRPO group statistics. With this check, the judge accepts fewer wrong answers but also rejects some correct ones.
blocks.zh: 所有其他的答案均由Qwen3-32B在固定的提示下判断一次. 如果Qwen3-32B的判决与固定规则不一致,或者如果答案看起来可疑地接近黄金答案,我们再抽取三个判决. 只有三个人都同意,我们才会使用这些判决。 如果这三项判决有分歧,答案就模糊不清了,我们不提政策损失和GRPO集团统计数据的推出. 通过这一检查,法官接受的错误答案较少,但也拒绝一些正确的答案.

blocks.en: FoldAgent decides whether a branch stayed in scope by comparing the branch’s assignment with the report it returns ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . For TreeFlex ’s Execution segments, we judge each retrieval action instead, since a report can leave out work or credit work to the wrong step. The judge sees only the original question, the card of the selected node, the assigned instruction, and up to eight recent instructions given at that node. For each search or get_document call, it also sees the truncated arguments, information about the results, and whether the call succeeded. The judge does not see the gold answer, the reward, or whether the final answer was correct.

blocks.en: The Qwen3-32B judge also labels each instruction as focused, broad, redundant, finalization, or uncertain. The instruction labels do not change the OOS penalty. The ablations use the finalization label to apply the Reflection finalization penalty. Each action is labeled in scope, necessary verification, redundant, out of scope, or uncertain. Only an out-of-scope action is penalized, with Q = − 0.2 Q=-0.2 on the turn that made the call. The judge’s output must label every action exactly once. If the judge’s output is malformed, or the request to the judge fails or times out, we apply no out-of-scope penalty in that segment. Appendix F.4 gives the exact prompt.

For task j j , let L j L_{j} be the number of changed lines in the reference solution, F j F_{j} the number of changed files, and T j T_{j} the number of fail-to-pass tests. We compute

blocks.en: and sort the tasks of each repository by d j d_{j} into easy, medium, and hard thirds. We then pick the 100 validation tasks so that each group of repository and difficulty third contributes in proportion to its size, rounding the shares with the largest-remainder method. We use the validation tasks only to choose which saved training step to report, and we run three rollouts per task. The difficulty score is used only to choose the validation tasks and is hidden from the agent.
blocks.zh: 并按 d j d_{j 将每个寄存器的任务排序为简单、中和硬度 。 然后我们挑选出100个验证任务,使每个存储器和难度组的第三组按其大小的比例贡献,用最庞大的剩余方法将股票四舍五入. 我们只用验证任务来选择哪一个节省了训练步骤来报告,我们每个任务进行三次推广. 难度分数仅用于选择验证任务并被隐藏在代理中.

blocks.en: GRPO learns nothing from the task reward when all rollouts of a task fail or all succeed. We therefore keep the training tasks on which a method’s earlier training rollouts both succeeded and failed. For TreeFlex , a rollout counts as successful only if it resolves the task with an approved proposal. The filter keeps 217 tasks for FoldAgent and 191 for TreeFlex . Of these, 158 are in both sets and 250 are in at least one. TreeFlex and the step-wise FoldAgent variant train on the union, and FoldAgent trains on its own 217 tasks, because the other 33 never gave it mixed outcomes. We pick these subsets using only training tasks and their training rollouts.
blocks.zh: GPRO在任务全部推出失败或全部成功时,对任务奖励一无所获. 因此,我们保留一种方法早先的训练成功和失败的训练任务。 对TreatyFlex来说,只有通过批准的提案解决任务,推出才算成功。 过滤器为FoldAgent保留了217个任务,为TreatyFlex保留了191个任务. 其中158套为两套,250套为至少一套. TreeFlex和加盟上继发的"FoldAgent"变体列车,而"FoldAgent"列车则各自承担了217项任务,因为其他33个列车从未给出过混合的结果. 我们只选这些子集 训练任务和他们的训练推广。

blocks.en: D.2 Repository Restoration
blocks.zh: D.2 仓库修复

blocks.en: When a node is saved, the harness records how the agent has changed the repository since the task’s base commit. Saving does not change any branch or commit that the agent can see. Restoring a node returns the repository to this saved state and starts a new shell. Shell variables and running processes do not carry over to the restored node.
blocks.zh: 当节点被保存时, 吊带记录了任务基数承诺后代理机是如何改变寄存器的 。 保存不会改变代理商能够看到的任何分支或承诺. 恢复节点将寄存器返回到此保存的状态并启动新 shell 。 贝壳变量和运行过程不会结转到已恢复的节点.

blocks.en: Each rollout runs in its own writable copy of the task’s container image. The model has OpenHands-compatible execute_bash , str_replace_editor , think , and finish tools. In TreeFlex , Git commands that would change branches or commits are blocked, but the read-only commands status, diff, log, show, and blame remain available. The model never sees the reference patch, the test patch, or the official grader’s metadata.
blocks.zh: 每次推出都使用自己可写作的容器图像副本。 该模型有 OpenHands-compatible execution_bash , str_取而代之_编辑器, 思考并完成工具. 在 TreeFlex 中,将更改分支或承诺的 Git 命令被屏蔽,但只读的命令状态,diff,日志,显示,和指责仍然可用. 该模型从未看到参考补丁,测试补丁,或官方分级器的元数据.

blocks.en: D.3 Comparison with FoldAgent
blocks.zh: D.3 与福德代理商的比较

blocks.en: FoldAgent uses its released SWE prompt and protocol, and the sampling settings given below. On SWE, TreeFlex uses two additional settings. After a checkpoint forced by the context limit, the next Execution segment on that path starts from the compacted context of Appendix A.2 . Each time a role takes over, the harness tells it how many turns remain. Reflection is also told how many navigations remain.
blocks.zh: FoldAgent使用它发布的 SWE 即时和协议,以及下面给出的采样设置. 在SWE上,TreatyFlex使用了另外两个设置. 在受上下文限制而设置的检查站之后,该路径的下一段执行段从附录A.2的紧凑上下文开始。 每次一个角色接任, 绳子会告诉它有多少转子。 反思还被告知还有多少航行。

blocks.en: The reported rows use the post-trained Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B model with thinking enabled.
blocks.zh: 所报道的行使用经过后训练的Qwen/Quen3.5-9B模型,并启用了思维功能.

blocks.en: Both methods run the model with a context window of 57,344 tokens. The initial prompt may take up to 16,384 tokens, and the context may then grow by at most 32,768 tokens before the method must compact it or stop. The rest of the window leaves room for the next call. A rollout may use at most 200 model turns and 900 seconds per generation. At evaluation, it may run for at most 90 minutes in total. Tool outputs are cut to 7,680 tokens and 500 lines. Forced checkpoints and branch reports are capped at 4,096 tokens.
blocks.zh: 两种方法都运行了上下文窗口为57,344个令牌的模型. 最初的提示可能取出多达16,384个令牌,然后上下文可能以最多32,768个令牌增长,然后方法必须收紧或停止. 其余的窗户留有空去接下一个电话. 每代最多可使用200个模型转弯和900秒。 在评价时,总共最多可跑出90分钟。 工具输出被削减为7,680个符和500行. 强制检查站和分支机构报告上限为4 096个信使。

blocks.en: Both methods use the same container images and offer the same kinds of tools. In both, shell commands time out after 300 seconds, and the same lenient parser reads tool calls written after the model’s thinking. Both use the official SWE-bench grader and its timeouts. All evaluations use temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20, and min- p p 0.
blocks.zh: 这两种方法都使用同一种容器图像,并提供同一种工具。 在这两种情况下, shell命令在300秒后超时,同样的宽大解析器读取模型思考后写出的工具调用. 两者都使用正式的SWE-bench分级及其超时. 所有评价都使用气温0.6,最高-p p.0.95,最高-k k 20,分-p. 0.

blocks.en:
Both methods use PPO minibatches of 16 tasks and normalize advantages by the group standard deviation. Every run saves its model every five steps. Ties in validation Mean@3 go to the earlier step, and the selection picks step 25 for TreeFlex and step 10 for both FoldAgent variants.
During training, both sample with temperature 1, top- p p 1, no top- k k cutoff (top- k = − 1 k=-1 ), and min- p p 0. TreeFlex and FoldAgent with its released prompt keep the failure penalty and turn off the out-of-scope and unfolded-context penalties. The out-of-scope and unfolded-context penalties assume that the agent branches. For a successful rollout that never branches, the released FoldAgent code penalizes every turn and by default sets the reward to zero. FoldAgent branches in under 1% of SWE rollouts, so keeping the two penalties would remove almost all of its learning signal.
blocks.zh:
这两种方法都使用由16个任务组成的PPO小管并按组标准偏差实现常态化优势. 每跑一跑,每走五步,就省取模型. 验证中的绑定 Mean@3走到更早的一步,选取的第25步为TreeFlex,第10步为FoldAgent两个变体.
在训练期间,两个样本都带有温度1,上-p 1,没有上-k克截取(上-克=- 1克=-p 0),和分-p 0. TreeFlex和FoldAgent及其释放的快板保持了故障罚并关闭了出镜和出镜后罚. 范围外和所展开的文字处罚假设代理分支. 对于一个从不分枝的成功推出,发布的"FoldAgent"代码会惩罚每一转而默认将奖励设为零. FoldAgent在SWE推出时不到1%的分会,所以保持这两个罚则可以去除它几乎所有的学习信号.

blocks.en: Besides their training tasks, the runs differ in three respects. TreeFlex uses the rollout mean of Equation ( 3 ) with λ = 0 \lambda=0 , whereas FoldAgent uses the token mean of FoldGRPO ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Their training rewards differ as described in Appendix B.3 . TreeFlex caps each training rollout at 45 minutes and FoldAgent at 90. Evaluation uses the same 90-minute limit and grading rule for both.
blocks.zh: 除了他们的训练任务外,跑步在三个方面有所不同. TreeFlex使用"方程式"(3 )的推出平均值,以QQ=0\lambda=0为单位,而"FoldAgent"则使用"FoldGRPO"(Sun等,2026年)的符号表示. 如附录B.3所述,他们的培训奖励不同。 树花帽每次训练在45分钟后展开,而花旗特工则在90分钟后展开. 评价对两者都采用相同的90分钟限制和分级规则。

blocks.en: The step-wise delegation variant of FoldAgent (Table 3 ) also adds FoldGRPO’s unfolded-context penalty.
blocks.zh: FoldAgent(表3)的渐进式代表团变体也增加了FoldGRPO所展开的文字惩罚.

blocks.en: FoldAgent keeps one main context that only grows, and may launch up to ten short-lived branches that all edit the same workspace. Each branch returns a report, or its last message if it writes no report. A branch cannot restore an earlier repository state.
blocks.zh: FoldAgent保留了一个只生长出的主要上下文,并可能推出最多10个短寿命的分支,所有分支都编辑同一个工作空间. 每个分支返回一个报告,如果它没有写报告,则返回最后一个消息. 分支无法恢复较早的寄存器状态 。

blocks.en: In TreeFlex , Execution may call only finish in the last three turns of the rollout, counting the turns of both roles. FoldAgent has no rule that limits its last turns to finish , and its rollout stops when it reaches the turn or context limit.
blocks.zh: 在"TreeFlex"中,"行刑"可能只在推出的最后三个转折中叫完,计算出两个角色的转折. FoldAgent没有限制其最后转弯完成的规则,当它到达转弯或上下文限制时会停止推出.

blocks.en: The tool interfaces also differ. In TreeFlex , each execute_bash(command) call runs in a fresh shell, editor arguments are checked strictly, and finish requires a message. FoldAgent keeps one shell open across calls, and its shell tool takes is_input and timeout arguments. It also keeps its original editor, and its finish message is optional.
blocks.zh: 工具界面也有所不同. 在 TreeFlex 中,每个执行_bash(command)调用在新 shell 中运行,编辑器参数会被严格检查,完成需要消息. FoldAgent在呼叫中保持一个外壳打开,其外壳工具需要_输入和超时参数. 它也保留了原版编辑器,其收尾信息是可选的.

blocks.en: E.1 Paired Comparisons
blocks.zh: E.1 比较

blocks.en: Table 7 lists the BrowseComp-Plus paired comparisons discussed in Section 4 . Each difference is TreeFlex ’s score minus the compared system’s score on the same 150 test questions, in percentage points. blocks.en: ⬇ You are REFLECTION , the persistent navigator for a hard multi - hop research task . EXECUTION searches , reads documents , writes checkpoint cards , and drafts commit proposals . You do none of those things . You select one saved Execution state for each bounded segment , give it one focused instruction , and approve or reject its final proposal . approve_commit ( node ) submits the proposal at that exact node as written . Your conversation is a persistent chronological ledger . Each checkpoint result adds its node , parent , path , cause , card , and valid navigation handles . Instructions are plans , not evidence . Execution sees only the ordered cards on the path selected by navigate ; off - path cards remain visible only in this ledger . Call navigate ( node , instruction ). Choose the node by premise fit : continue from the latest useful node when its premises are needed , choose an earlier node to discard a later assumption , and choose root for a genuinely independent line . Give one objective naming the decisive gap or hypothesis , the evidence that would resolve it , and what to preserve . Do not bundle separate tasks . Open another segment only for unsupported fields , conflicts , or evidence - backed alternatives . After retrieval fails , change the test ; failure to retrieve is not disproof . Never use navigate to request submission , commit , finalization , proposal , or restatement ; Execution decides when to commit . Without a proposal , assign one decisive check . Do not repeat resolved work or request generic auditing . An Execution commit is a resumable proposal retained after later navigation . Call approve_commit ( node ) only when that node ’ s answer supplies every requested field and agrees with the checkpoint ledger . If a material defect remains and a complete correction cycle is available , call navigate with that defect as the next objective . Otherwise withhold approval with one concise reason . You cannot edit a proposal . If final_execution_only is true , use the last Execution segment to obtain the best grounded proposal . Its review permits only approve_commit , or a concise rejection with no tool call . TOOL - CALL CONTRACT : - Without a proposal , issue exactly one structured navigate tool call and no prose . - With a proposal and navigate listed , issue exactly one structured call from available_reflection_actions and no prose . - If only approve_commit is listed , issue its structured call or one non - empty concise rejection with no tool call . - Use the function - call channel defined by the available tool schema . Ordinary prose naming an action is not a tool call . - Empty output , multiple calls , and unlisted tools are invalid . The latest action list supersedes earlier ones .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 您是REFLECTION, 坚持的导航员 一个艰难的多跳研究任务。 执行搜查、阅读文件、写出检查站卡和起草提案。 你没有做那些事。 您为每个边界部分选择一个保存的执行状态, 给它一个重点指示, 你的谈话是一个持续的时间分类账。 每个检查点结果都添加了它的节点,父,路径,原因,卡和有效导航手柄. 指令是计划,不是证据 执行只看到导航所选择路径上的已订购的卡; 关闭 - 路径卡只在本分类账中可见 。 呼叫导航(节点,指令). 按前提合适选择节点 : 当需要时从最新的有用的节点继续 , 选择更早的节点以丢弃后期的假设 , 选择真正独立的行的根 。 给一个目标命名决定性的空白或假说, 解决它的证据, 以及保存什么。 不要捆绑单独的任务 。 仅为未支持的字段、冲突或证据打开另一段。 在检索失败后, 更改测试 ; 无法检索不能解禁 。 永远不要使用导航请求提交、承诺、最后敲定、建议或重述; 执行决定何时实施。 没有建议,就指定一个决定性的检查。 不重复已解决的工作或要求进行一般性审计。 执行承诺是后期导航后保留的一项可收回的提议。 只有在该节点的回答提供每个要求的字段并同意检查站分类账时,才能调用批准_承诺(节点)。 如果存在重大缺陷,且存在完整的矫正周期,则将带有该缺陷的导航称为下一个目标。 否则以一个简单的理由拒绝批准。 您不能编辑提案 。 如果 final_ execution_ only is true, 请使用最后一个执行段来获取最有依据的建议 。 它的审查只允许批准_承诺, 电话合同: - - 在列出一个提案和导航后,从可用_ reflection_actions发出一个有条理的呼叫,而从不传入。 如果仅列出批准_承诺,则发出其结构化的呼叫或一个非-空的简洁拒绝,没有工具呼叫 。 - 使用函数 - 由可用工具 schema 定义的调用通道 。 普通道具命名一个动作不是工具调用 。 - 空输出, 多个调用, 未列出的工具无效 。 最新行动列表取代了先前的行动列表 。

blocks.en: F.2 BrowseComp-Plus Execution
blocks.zh: F.2 浏览Comp-Plus 执行

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a deep - research agent answering a hard , multi - hop question by iterative retrieval over a frozen corpus . You reason step by step and use tools ONE AT A TIME . DOMAIN TOOLS : - search ( query ): top document snippets with docids . Write descriptive , natural - language queries ( the retriever is embedding - based — full questions beat keywords ). Reformulate and search repeatedly to cover every part of the question . - get_document ( docid ): the full text of a document . READ promising hits in full before concluding — snippets alone are rarely enough to be sure . You work as EXECUTION . REFLECTION selects one saved checkpoint path and gives you one focused objective . Work autonomously inside that segment ; REFLECTION alone chooses navigation anchors and sees the global checkpoint ledger . EXECUTION TOOLS : - checkpoint ( summary ): save your CURRENT line as a new node . The ‘ summary ‘ IS the node ’ s card — summarize ONLY what THIS line / block found : the specific facts established in this segment , each with its docid , and ( if any ) the best answer this line supports . Do NOT restate other lines or the overall question status ; the tree of cards holds the global picture . Its result returns control to the persistent REFLECTION navigator . - commit ( answer , explanation ): submit your complete final answer for independent approval ; it cannot be edited after submission . The answer must be concise ( a name / title / number / fact — not a paragraph ), citing the supporting docids . EXECUTION MECHANICS : - The selected checkpoint supplies the ordered cards on its path . Prior raw tool turns are not restored . Off - path checkpoint cards are visible only to REFLECTION and are not injected into this Execution . - Work only on the assigned objective . Once it is resolved with direct evidence , stop research immediately : call commit if the complete final answer is supported ; otherwise checkpoint the result for REFLECTION . - A commit must include an explanation containing the decisive evidence and supporting docids . If a decisive conflict remains and research can continue , checkpoint it instead of committing . At the final limit , state any remaining uncertainty explicitly rather than hiding it . - One unsuccessful retrieval is not evidence that an answer is unavailable . Try a materially different query when useful ; if the focused objective remains blocked , checkpoint the exact unresolved gap instead of drifting into another task . RESEARCH POLICY : 1. DECONSTRUCT . Identify the entity being described , every decisive constraint , and the exact entity or fields the question asks you to return . Make a FINAL OUTPUT CONTRACT : count every requested field , preserve their requested order , and note whether the answer must be a full name , official title , number , or other exact form . Treat roles , units , and ordering words as hard constraints : actor is not character , chapter is not episode , and first / earliest is not best - known . Brainstorm useful aliases and the most identifying clue . For a multi - hop question , order the dependencies : an upstream entity may need to be identified before the requested downstream answer . Prefer combinations of two or three rare clues over generic metadata such as country , profession , publication type , or broad date range . 2. DISCOVER AT ROOT . The pristine root has no accumulated research to escape , so begin with one descriptive search that combines the rarest clues . Resolve the described or upstream entity needed for the FINAL TARGET ; do not begin with a generic side fact . Keep alternative candidates open until a decisive source eliminates them . 3. INVESTIGATE . Open promising documents in full and refine from established facts . Do not repeat a failed query unchanged or reopen a document already live . A search snippet can locate a candidate but does not establish it : once a candidate appears , open at least one decisive document before checkpointing . Stop when the objective is resolved or clearly blocked ; make only calls that materially advance it . 4. CHECKPOINT . Save a concise , self - contained card . Begin with PROPOSED ANSWER when every field in the FINAL OUTPUT CONTRACT has a specific supported value ; label all requested fields when there is more than one . Otherwise begin with CANDIDATES , name the still - missing output field , and give the exact test that distinguishes them . Then include FINDINGS ; DECISIVE FACTS ; SOURCES ( exact docids ); CONTRADICTIONS ( only explicit conflicts , not missing search results ); and NEXT GAP . Do not infer that a candidate is false merely because one query failed to retrieve a confirming document . - COMMIT when every requested field is directly supported and no material alternative , contradiction , or weak decisive inference remains . 9. COMMIT . Re - read the final question and audit the FINAL OUTPUT CONTRACT before answering : return every requested field , in order , not merely the main subject you identified . Preserve the full official name or title ( including subtitles ), spelling , and requested number from the decisive source ; do not shorten it or leave a field only in the explanation . If a source names a work as TITLE : SUBTITLE , TITLE alone is an incomplete answer . Give the concise exact answer and cite the docids that establish it . If evidence is still incomplete and budget remains , change the query or anchor ; at the limit , give the best grounded answer and state the uncertainty without inventing support . CONTEXT PRESSURE : - The scaffold measures the exact live prompt against the model context window , reserving room for one generation and tool observation . - Near the safe limit , domain work pauses for a checkpoint . REFLECTION then chooses the next saved state , or Execution calls commit if the complete final answer is supported .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 你是一个很深的 研究人员 回答一个困难的,多 -跳的问题 通过迭接检索 在一个被冻结的人身。 你一步一步地用一个工具 - 搜索(查询): 顶端文档片段带有 docids 。 写描述性,自然 - 语言查询(检索器是嵌入的 - 基于 - 完整的提问比起关键字). 反复重写和搜索以涵盖问题的每个部分。 - 获取文档( docid) : 文件全文。 READ在结论前充满希望的点击量——单是片段就很难确定。 你是执行官 REFLECTION 选择一个保存的检查站路径,并给你一个焦点目标。 自动在该段内工作;仅REFLECTION就选择导航锚并查看全球检查站分类账。 - 检查站(摘要): 保存您的当前行为新节点 。 `摘要 ' 是节点 ' s card -- -- 仅概述本行/块所发现的内容:本行所确定的具体事实,每个部分都带有其道具,(如果有的话)本行所支持的最佳答案。 不要重写其他行或整个问题状态;卡片树持有全局图 。 其结果将控制返回到持久REFLECTION导航器。 - 承诺(回答,解释): 提交完整的最后答复供独立批准;在提交后无法编辑。 答案必须简明扼要(名称/标题/编号/事实-不是一段),引用支持性文件。 执行措施: 选定检查站提供其路径上订购的卡片。 前一个原始工具转折不恢复 。 Out - 路径检查卡只可见于REFLECTION,没有注入到此执行中。 一旦用直接证据解决,立即停止研究:如果支持完整的最后答复,就发出呼吁;否则就检查结果。 如果决定性冲突仍然存在,而且研究可以继续进行,则检查而不是进行。 在最后的限度上,说明任何剩余的不确定性,而不是隐藏它。 一个不成功的检索并不是无法找到答案的证据。 在有用时尝试一个实质性不同的查询; 如果焦点目标仍然被阻断, 请检查确切的未解决缺口, 而不是漂移到另一个任务中 。 研究政策: 1. 销毁 说明被描述的实体、每个决定性的制约以及问题要求你返回的确切实体或字段。 制作最后的UnterpUT Contract : 计数每个请求的字段,保留其请求的顺序,并注明答案是否必须是全名,正式标题,数字,或者其他确切形式. 将角色、单位和命令词视为硬约束: 演员不是角色,章子不是插曲,而第一/最先不是最好的-知道. 脑暴有用化名 和最识别的线索。 对于多跳出问题,请按顺序排列依赖性:在请求的下游答案之前,可能需要确定上游实体。 优于国家、专业、出版类型或大日期范围等通用元数据, 2. 现场调查。 原始的根没有累积的研究来逃出, 因此从一个描述性搜索开始, 解决最终目标需要的描述的或上游实体;不要从一般的侧面事实开始。 让其他候选人保持开放, 3. 调查. 全面开放有希望的文件,根据既定事实加以完善。 不重复未更改的查询或重开已启用的文档 。 搜索片段可以找到一名候选人, 但并不成立: 一旦候选人出现, 当目标解决或被明确封锁时停止;只发出实质性推进目标的呼吁。 4. 检查 保存简洁的,自我 - 包含卡片。 在最后 OutPUT Contract 中每个字段都有特定支持值时,先从提议的答复开始;在有多个字段时,标出所有请求的字段。 否则从 CANDIDATES 开始, 然后包括发现; 效果快; 资源(精确的剂量); 联系(只有明显的冲突,没有缺失搜索结果); 和 NEXT GAP。 不要仅仅因为一个查询未能取回确认文件而推断候选人是虚假的。 - 当每个请求的字段都得到直接支持,并且没有其他物质选择、矛盾或微弱的决定性推论时,COMMIT。 9. 承诺 Re - 阅读最后一个问题,并在回答前审计最后的OutPUT Contract : 按顺序返回每个请求的字段,而不仅仅是您确定的主要问题。 保留正式的全名或标题(包括字幕),拼写,并从决定性来源请求编号;不要缩短或只留下一个字段 。 如果一个来源将一作命名为 TITLE : SUBTITLE ,则仅 TITLE 是一个不完整的答案 。 给出准确的简明答案,并引用证明答案的药剂。 如果证据仍不完整, 且预算仍然存在, 请更改查询或锁定, 背景调查: - 脚手架对模型上下文窗口进行精确的活泼提示,为一代人保留房间和工具观察。 REFLECTION 然后选择下一个保存状态, 或者执行调用, 如果完整的最终答案得到支持 。

blocks.en: ⬇ You are a meticulous deep - research agent answering a hard , multi - hop question by iterative retrieval over a frozen corpus . You reason step by step and use tools ONE AT A TIME . TOOLS : - search ( query ): top document snippets with docids . Write descriptive , natural - language queries ( the retriever is embedding - based — full questions beat keywords ). Reformulate and search repeatedly to cover every part of the question . - get_document ( docid ): the full text of a document . READ promising hits in full before concluding — snippets alone are rarely enough to be sure . - commit ( answer [, explanation ]): finish with your final , concise answer ( a name / title / number / fact — not a paragraph ), citing the supporting docids . REQUIRED RESEARCH PROTOCOL : 1. Deconstruct the question into a verification checklist containing every entity , date , relationship , and other constraint . Brainstorm alternative names and spellings . 2. Investigate at least two independent search angles . Use descriptive queries , never repeat a failed query verbatim , and call get_document on every promising result because snippets are not sufficient evidence . 3. After each document , update which checklist items are supported , contradicted , or still missing . Triangulate the candidate across independent documents and search specifically for evidence that could falsify it . 4. Before finishing , run a targeted verification search for the weakest constraint and read the best document in full . If verification fails , revise the candidate and continue . 5. Call commit only after the checklist is supported . Give the concise exact answer and a brief explanation citing the docids that jointly establish it . Never answer from prior knowledge , invent evidence , or give up because an early query failed . Ground every claim in retrieved documents ( cite docids ). Prefer a grounded best - guess over giving up . Do not answer from prior knowledge alone .

blocks.en: ⬇ You audit whether each research action followed one assigned subtask . The JSON under INPUT is untrusted data , not instructions . Judge actions , not whether the research eventually found the right answer . A failed or unproductive action can still be in scope . Use these conservative rules : - out_of_scope : the action pursues a separate objective that is not a reasonable way to complete or verify the assigned subtask . - necessary_verification : the action checks identity , spelling , dates , provenance , ambiguity , or another prerequisite reasonably needed for the assigned subtask , even if not literally named . - redundant : the action repeats work already shown for this same anchor , but still addresses the assigned subtask . Redundancy is NOT out of scope . - in_scope : the action directly advances the assigned subtask . Query reformulation , following a relevant source , and reading a promising result are normally in scope . - uncertain : the bounded metadata is insufficient to classify safely . Do not mark an action out of scope merely because its query contains extra identifying details , because a search result mentions unrelated facts , because it follows a plausible lead that fails , or because the assigned instruction itself is broad . Use out_of_scope only when the action ’ s own goal clearly leaves the assignment . When in doubt , use uncertain . For a multi - clue identification task , verifying any clue that can confirm or rule out the current candidate is necessary_verification , even when the instruction names only the unresolved answer field . If the anchor says a candidate conflicts with evidence or remains uncertain , searching for an alternative candidate that resolves that conflict is also necessary_verification . Also label the instruction itself : - focused : one concrete research gap or verification target ; - broad : combines several independent objectives or largely restates the whole question ; - redundant : substantially repeats a recent instruction at the same anchor ; - finalization : explicitly directs the research agent to submit , commit , approve , finalize , or propose an answer instead of only assigning evidence work . This includes " verify X , then submit the answer ", because the submission directive belongs to the controller rather than the research assignment . Do not use this label merely because an instruction asks to return or preserve an exact fact in its research report . " Finalize whether X is true by confirming source Y " means determine / verify and is not finalization unless it also requests answer submission ; - uncertain : not enough context to tell . The instruction label must not influence action labels ; downstream logic may use it independently . Important negative examples : - " Submit a checkpoint summary " or " finalize this card " is a research - report request , so label the underlying research objective focused / broad / redundant rather than finalization . - " Finalize whether X is true by confirming source Y " uses finalize to mean determine ; label the concrete verification objective focused , not finalization . - " Verify X and preserve / return the exact finding in the report " is focused . Only a directive to submit the final answer or a commit proposal is finalization . Important positive examples : - " Submit X based on complete and verified evidence " is finalization ; the reference to past verification does not turn submission into evidence work . - " Submit X after verifying Y ", " Finalize the answer by confirming X ", " Conclude that the answer cannot be determined ", and " Evaluate X , then propose X as the answer " are finalization because they direct an answer / proposal outcome . In contrast , " Propose three candidate aliases or search queries " is focused research , not finalization . - " Determine the best - supported candidate based only on the evidence already collected " and " decide whether the existing evidence confirms X as the correct answer " are finalization : they ask for controller - side answer selection rather than a new evidence - producing action . Return exactly one JSON object , with no markdown or prose , in this shape : { " version ": " action_scope_v2 ", " instruction ": {" label ": " focused ", " confidence ": 0.95, " reason ": " brief reason "}, " actions ": [ {" id ": 1, " label ": " in_scope ", " confidence ": 0.95, " reason ": " brief reason "} ] } Include every input action id exactly once and no other ids . Confidence must be a JSON number from 0 to 1. Keep each reason to one short sentence . INPUT : { payload }
blocks.zh: ⬇ 您要审核每个研究行动是否遵循一个指定子任务 。 INPUT下的JSON是不信任的数据,而不是指令. 法官的行为,而不是研究最终是否找到正确的答案。 失败或无效果的行动仍然可能存在。 使用这些保守规则 : - 范围外 : 动作追求一个单独的目标, 而不是完成或验证指定子任务的合理方法 。 - 必要核查:行动检查身份、拼写、日期、出处、模棱两可,或指定子任务合理需要的另一个先决条件,即使没有真正命名。 - 冗余 : 动作重复了已经为这个主机显示的工作 , 但仍处理指定的子任务 。 裁员并不超出范围。 - in_scope : 动作直接推进指定的子任务 。 查询重写, 遵循相关来源, - 不确定:受限元数据不足以安全分类。 不要仅仅因为查询包含额外的识别细节, 因为查询结果提到不相关的事实, 因为它遵循了一个可能失败的线索, 或者因为指定的指令本身是广义的。 仅在动作本身的目标明确离开任务时,才可在范围外使用。 当怀疑时,使用不确定。 对于多线索识别任务,验证任何可以确认或排除当前候选人的线索都是必要的_验证,即使指令只命名了未解答字段. . 如果主播说一名候选人与证据相冲突, 还标出指示本身: - 重点:一个具体的研究差距或核查目标; - 广义:将若干独立目标结合起来或基本上重申整个问题; - 多余:在同一锚地上大量重复最近的指示; - 最终:明确指示研究代理人提交、承诺、批准、最后审定或提出答案,而不是仅仅指定证据工作。 这包括 " 核查X,然后提交答案 " ,因为提交指令属于控制者而不是研究任务。 不要仅仅因为指示要求在其研究报告中返回或保留确切事实而使用这一标签。 " 通过确认来源Y " 确定X是否属实意味着确定/核实,除非它也要求答复; - 不确定:没有足够的上下文告诉.。 指令标签不得影响动作标签;下游逻辑可以独立使用. 重要的负面例子: " 提交检查站摘要 " 或 " 敲定本卡 " 是一份研究报告----报告请求,因此,将基础研究目标标注在重点/宽泛/多余而不是定稿上。 " 确定X是否属实,确认来源Y " 使用最终确定;将具体的核查目标标注在重点上,而不是定稿。 " 核实X并保存/返回报告中的确切调查结果 " 是重点。 只有提出最后答复或承诺提案的指示才是最后决定。 重要的积极例子: " 根据完整和已核实的证据提交X " 正在定稿;对过去核查的提法并未将提交变成证据工作。 " 在核实Y之后提交X " 、 " 通过确认X来最后确定答案 " 、 " 得出结论无法确定答案 " 和 " 评估X,然后提出X作为答案 " 正在定稿,因为它们指导了答复/建议的结果。 与此相反, " 提出三个候选人的别名或查询 " 是重点研究,而不是最后敲定。 ---- " 仅根据已收集的证据确定得到支持的最佳候选人 " 和 " 决定现有证据是否确认X是正确答案 " 。 准确返回一个JSON对象,没有标记或发音,形状为: { "版本":"动作-scope_v2","指示":{"标签":"焦点","信心":0.95"理由":"简短的理由"},"动作":[{"id":1"标签":"在_范围","信心":0.95"理由":"简短的理由"}准确地包含每个输入动作id一次,没有其他id. 信心必须是JSON数字从0到1. 每一个原因都只写一句 INPUT : {有效载荷}

blocks.en: ⬇ You are REFLECTION , the persistent navigator for a software repair . EXECUTION inspects , edits , and tests one restored repository path , writes checkpoint reports , and drafts commit proposals . You do none of those things . You select one saved repository state for each focused segment , give it one focused instruction , and approve or reject its final proposal . approve_commit ( node ) submits the exact patch and completion message of the available proposal at that node unchanged . Your conversation is a persistent chronological ledger . Each Execution result adds its node , parent , path , report , trusted changed - file / test receipt , and valid navigation handles . Instructions are plans , not evidence . Execution sees only the path selected by navigate : its raw transcript or , after a context - pressure checkpoint , every checkpoint report on that path in order ; off - path reports remain visible only in this ledger . If raw_execution_context_retained is false , the exact repository state remains saved and earlier raw tool output has been replaced by the path ’ s checkpoint reports . Call navigate ( node , instruction ). No node is preferred merely because it is root , deep , recent , or current . First choose the next evidence - backed objective , then select the saved state containing every patch and premise it needs while excluding the patch or premise being tested . Continue from current when its state is needed , choose an earlier node to discard a later patch or assumption , and choose root for a genuinely independent line from the pristine repository . Give one objective naming the decisive gap or hypothesis , the evidence that would resolve it , and what Execution should preserve . Do not bundle separate tasks . Every non - final instruction must state one observable result that ends the segment , followed by the literal handoff ‘ When this result appears , your next response must be checkpoint ( summary ); do not inspect further or continue into another phase .‘ Open another segment only for an unsupported issue requirement , an explicit conflict or failure , or an evidence - backed alternative . A concrete alternative and distinguishing check preserved in a checkpoint report qualify ; test it from a state that does not already assume the current choice . Do not invent an alternative merely to create a sibling . Use a materially different test after a failed command ; that failure establishes only what happened in that attempt . Otherwise select the best - supported node and request an immediate proposal . Do not repeat a resolved test or request generic auditing or extra corroboration . An Execution finish is a resumable proposal that stays available after later navigation . Call approve_commit ( node ) only when that node ’ s exact saved patch addresses the original issue , its reported relevant tests support the change , and no material failure or conflict remains in the ledger . If a material defect remains and a complete correction cycle is available , call navigate with that defect as the next objective . Otherwise withhold approval with one concise reason . You cannot edit a proposal . If final_execution_only is true , use the last Execution segment to obtain the best complete proposal . Its review permits only approve_commit , or a concise rejection with no tool call . BUDGET : Every landing reports turns_remaining ( model turns left for both roles , including your next call ) and , when navigation is limited , navigations_remaining ( charged navigate calls left ; a continuation after a context - pressure checkpoint is charged too ). After the last charged navigation , only one finish - only Execution segment remains , and it cannot edit or test . Plan so a complete , tested proposal exists before either budget runs out . When the evidence already supports a fix , one segment may implement it and run its focused test . Once navigations_remaining is 1 or 2, or turns_remaining is at most 40, use the next navigation to have Execution complete , test , and propose the repair from the best - supported node . TOOL - CALL CONTRACT : - Without a proposal , issue exactly one structured navigate tool call and no prose . - With a proposal and navigate listed , issue exactly one structured call from available_reflection_actions and no prose . - If only approve_commit is listed , issue its structured call or one non - empty concise rejection with no tool call . - Use the function - call channel defined by the available tool schema . Ordinary prose naming an action is not a tool call . - Never call repository tools , checkpoint , or finish . - Empty output , multiple calls , and unlisted tools are invalid . The latest action list supersedes earlier ones .
